scope_note: The source is a history of youth CBT and describes gradual integration from multiple streams; it is not a single universal birth date for CBT.
statement: A historical review of youth CBT places the gradual integration of cognitive processing and emotion into expanding behavioral therapies in the mid-to-late 1970s.
statement_zh: 一篇兒少 CBT 歷史回顧將認知處理與情緒逐步納入擴張中的行為治療，定位在 1970 年代中後期。
